plugin.name: NCMLyricsBar NetEase Lyrics
plugin.description: Synchronized bilingual NetEase lyrics from Firefox: original, thin separator and translation.
settings.font_family.label: Lyrics font
settings.primary_color.label: Original text color
settings.secondary_color.label: Translation color
settings.separator_color.label: Separator color
settings.offset_ms.label: Timing offset (ms; positive means earlier)
settings.api_mode.label: Lyrics source
settings.api_url.label: API URL template
settings.api_url.hint: Supports {id}, {title}, {artist}, {album} and {duration}; values are URL-encoded automatically.
settings.lyric_path.label: JSON original lyrics field
settings.lyric_path.hint: For example: lrc.lyric or syncedLyrics. Not needed for APIs returning plain LRC text.
settings.translation_path.label: JSON translation field
settings.translation_path.hint: For example: tlyric.lyric. Leave blank if there is no translation.
